VX004.work: Atlas is the whole job right now. My week is planning, unblocking people and arguing for headcount.
VX004.life: I live in HSR Layout with my wife and our two kids. Saturday mornings I try to cycle to Nandi Hills; most Saturdays I don't get up in time.
VX004.mood: Stretched. I asked for more people and didn't get them. I'd still rather ship Atlas late than ship it broken.
VX004.leave_note: That week in October was Kerala, with my parents. First real break this year.

VX007.work: I own the routing core and most of the re-routing work. If something in the engine breaks, it usually ends up with me.
VX007.life: I live in Indiranagar. My mother moved in with me this year, so evenings are more about home than they used to be. I still try to get to the climbing gym on Sundays.
VX007.mood: Tired, if I'm honest. I like the problem. I'm less sure the load is sustainable.
VX007.leave_note: The half-days were personal. I'd rather not go into it.

VX009.life: My partner got a job in Pune, so we moved there this year. We're near Baner, and it turns out I like living somewhere I can see hills.
VX009.mood: Good. Pune has worked out. My worry is being out of sight when decisions get made in Bengaluru.
VX009.leave_note: The relocation week was the move itself, boxes and all.

VX012.work: I'm the only SRE on staff, so reliability, alerts and deploys all land on me.
VX012.life: I share a flat in Koramangala with two friends from college. I play badminton twice a week when work allows.
VX012.mood: Busy. I'd like one quiet month. I don't think I've had one this year.
VX012.leave_note: The two sick days in April were a bad bout of flu.

VX018.leave_note: One day off in July for a cousin's wedding.

VX003.leave_note: I haven't taken proper leave this year. That's probably a problem.

VX010.work: Planning and forecasts. I also covered February payroll while Fatima was away.

VX010.mood: A bit behind on forecasts. The exams eat my evenings.

VX014.life: I got married in February. We've just set up a flat in Frazer Town, and weekends are mostly family visits on both sides.

VX015.life: I live in Kolkata with my parents. Sundays are for football, watching or playing.

VX015.leave_note: I haven't taken leave this year.

VX011.work: Paid channels, mostly Google Ads, and making the numbers add up.
